wording: v1: one line per installed non-kit pack, derived from the card's TL;DR / 'What it is' (rnd/research/packs/<id>.md); kit packs boar-crypto + boar-wikivoyage-en are always searched and not listed
none: the question is general or about travel/crypto, which the base app already covers

packs.qa-travel-se: Travel Stack Exchange Q&A: travellers' practical questions on visas, border and customs rules, airlines, airports, transit and overstays.
packs.qa-ethereum-se: Ethereum Stack Exchange Q&A: Ethereum development questions on Solidity, smart contracts, web3 libraries, clients, gas, EIPs and wallets.
packs.qa-bitcoin-se: Bitcoin Stack Exchange Q&A: questions on the Bitcoin protocol, transactions, scripts, keys, wallets, mining, nodes and Lightning.
packs.qa-health-se: Medical Sciences Stack Exchange Q&A: health and medical explanation questions on the body, diseases, drugs, treatments and research evidence.
packs.qa-outdoors-se: Outdoors Stack Exchange Q&A: hiking, camping, backpacking, gear, navigation, wildlife, wilderness skills and outdoor safety questions.
packs.boar-firstaid-en: First aid and preparedness: emergency first aid, casualty care, disaster readiness, survival skills, water, shelter and self-reliance (Wikipedia, Appropedia, US Army manuals).
packs.boar-medlineplus-en: MedlinePlus health topics: US National Library of Medicine plain-language summaries of diseases, conditions, symptoms, tests, treatments and wellness.
packs.boar-factbook: CIA World Factbook: per-country facts (capital, population, area, languages, government, economy, geography, military) for every country, territory and ocean.
packs.boar-simplewiki-en: Simple English Wikipedia: about 208,000 plain-English encyclopedia articles on people, places, history, science, nature and culture.
